latest_cos_commentary.headline: Developer-led in-person and online payments infrastructure can enter through restaurant software platforms.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Developer-led in-person and online payments infrastructure can enter through restaurant software platforms.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Stripe announced expanded Terminal payment-method support in its 2026 Sessions product update. Second check: Stripe says restaurant payment platform qlub uses it for QR and in-person terminal payments.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Map whether Stripe is processor, gateway or platform partner in each account before comparing Worldpay economics.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Release timetable varies by feature; this source does not establish a named restaurant deployment. qlub is a platform partner; do not label every underlying restaurant a direct Stripe customer without account evidence.
